# Pi-hole v5.18.4 input validators, as NAME=<regex> lines (see PROVENANCE).
#
# Each entry quotes its source line verbatim on a "#| " line, after a
# "# <file>:<line>" line naming advanced/Scripts/<file> at tag v5.18.4. The
# NAME=<regex> line is that source mechanically turned into a Go regexp that
# MATCHES an accepted value (TestUpstreamValidatorsDeriveFromSource checks the
# derivation):
#   grep -P "<re>"        -> <re> with bash's double-quote "\\" -> "\" applied
#   =~ [^<set>] / regex="[^<set>]" (match = refused) -> ^[<set>]*$
#   -le <n>               -> ^.{0,<n>}$
# The NAME is the upstream function the check belongs to; a function with
# several checks has one entry per check, and a value passes the function
# only if it passes all of them.

# list.sh:110 (ValidateDomain, total length)
#|         if [[ "${#domain}" -le 253 ]]; then
ValidateDomainLength=^.{0,253}$

# list.sh:111 (ValidateDomain, valid characters)
#|             validDomain=$(grep -P "^((-|_)*[a-z\\d]((-|_)*[a-z\\d])*(-|_)*)(\\.(-|_)*([a-z\\d]((-|_)*[a-z\\d])*))*$" <<< "${domain}") # Valid chars check
ValidateDomain=^((-|_)*[a-z\d]((-|_)*[a-z\d])*(-|_)*)(\.(-|_)*([a-z\d]((-|_)*[a-z\d])*))*$

# list.sh:112 (ValidateDomain, length of each label)
#|             validDomain=$(grep -P "^[^\\.]{1,63}(\\.[^\\.]{1,63})*$" <<< "${validDomain}") # Length of each label
ValidateDomainLabels=^[^\.]{1,63}(\.[^\.]{1,63})*$

# list.sh:267 (GetComment)
#|     if [[ "${comment}" =~ [^a-zA-Z0-9_\#:/\.,\ -] ]]; then
GetComment=^[a-zA-Z0-9_\#:/\.,\ -]*$

# webpage.sh:542 (CheckUrl; line 546 first strips one "userinfo@", which Nexus never admits)
#|     regex="[^a-zA-Z0-9:/?&%=~._()-;]"
CheckUrl=^[a-zA-Z0-9:/?&%=~._()-;]*$
